name: tar
description: ustar archive creation, listing and extraction (freestanding port)
note: Ported to the CodeOS freestanding toolchain: src/tar.c. Host tests: tests/run.sh. Upstream archive kept under ports/tar/upstream/ as reference; the original .ftech declared size is retained in `size`. Directories come from sys_readdir (sys_stat is broken on this kernel); symlinks/hardlinks and -z are not supported.
